campaign_name: Normal Campaign Lifecycle and Branch Continuity
purpose: Review normal UI creation, start, branch choice, save/resume and continuity, including preserved failures.
objective_status: B — PARTIAL / BOTH NORMAL PLAYER LIFECYCLES DEMONSTRATED; FINAL HOLDOUT COVERAGE INCOMPLETE
executive_summary: Both normal browser lifecycles demonstrated; one frozen holdout 46/50 precedes targeted persistence/import repairs. Final-source holdout/browser coverage incomplete. No commit/push.

production: Explicit default-off new-campaign enrollment; trusted prerequisite disclosure; full transcript resume; bounded start deadline/busy guards.
Bounded same-file Windows rename retry and failed-New-Campaign rollback; existing adapter dependency retained.
validation: 50-case frozen developer holdout once: 46 passed, four failures retained.
Final focused recovery/publication/branch and boundary checks; separate baseline comparison for newly measured startup failures.
tooling: Isolated normal browser/TCP host, full transport/authority capture and selected sanitized review export.
generated_artifacts: Original failure traces, screenshots, frozen manifest/source and final repair results.

testing.broader: Nine historical authority failures; exact XML/log included.
testing.full_suite: Not run; no official ATGB or external independence.
testing.runtime_validation: Both normal UI branches plus separate TCP replay; final persistence repair has final TCP but no live-browser rerun.
testing.model_runtime_boundary: 15 live requests, 189036 tokens including preflight/required gameplay; no shadow study.
testing.new_regressions: PR49 direct-import regression fixed and retested; temporary test directory collisions retained then rerun with isolated basetemp.
testing.pre_existing_failures: Three historical focused, nine broader, plus six newly measured startup failures verified against exact entry API.

campaign_specific: Frozen holdout precedes final recovery changes; raw score 46/50.
Cached frontend initially kept the previous transcript; reopened context verified current frontend.
Complete per-operation browser startup/substage timings unavailable.
pre_existing: Six startup failures reproduced on entry API.
Permanent filesystem outages can still prevent rollback.

missing_concepts: Final-source fresh holdout and live-browser coverage for final persistence repair.
does_not_prove: Full suite, official ATGB, external independent validation, process-crash durability, multiplayer authorization or broad open-world initiative.
recommended_next_step: PR-PLAY-71 verification closure: use a fresh, correctly specified holdout against the final persistence repair, including transient and permanent Windows rename failures. Preserve this frozen run without rerunning or tuning it.
self_contained_review_test: 23 requested reports, exact player-facing responses, original failure traces, final repair checks, explicit baseline and scope limits.
